name: @luniiya/halo-web-link
description: Headless anti-detection browser for AI agents over MCP - element refs, session isolation, and a live dashboard
author: Luniiya

tools.name: hwl_create_tab
tools.description: Open a new browser tab at a URL

tools.name: hwl_snapshot
tools.description: Get accessibility snapshot with element refs

tools.name: hwl_read_text
tools.description: Cheap text-only page read (no tree, no refs, no screenshot)

tools.name: hwl_click
tools.description: Click by ref, CSS selector, or viewport coordinates

tools.name: hwl_wait
tools.description: Wait for page readiness, a selector, text, or URL

tools.name: hwl_wait_for_reply
tools.description: Wait for new chat messages and typing status without repeated snapshots

tools.name: hwl_keep_open
tools.description: Protect a tab from automatic cleanup

tools.name: hwl_tab_history
tools.description: Read closed-tab recovery information and saved text

tools.name: hwl_mouse
tools.description: Move, hover, or drag the native browser mouse

tools.name: hwl_type
tools.description: Type text into an element

tools.name: hwl_select
tools.description: Select an option in a native <select> dropdown

tools.name: hwl_navigate
tools.description: Navigate to URL or search macro

tools.name: hwl_scroll
tools.description: Scroll page up/down/left/right

tools.name: hwl_screenshot
tools.description: Capture page screenshot

tools.name: hwl_close_tab
tools.description: Close a browser tab

tools.name: hwl_evaluate
tools.description: Execute JavaScript in a Camoufox tab page context

tools.name: hwl_list_tabs
tools.description: List open tabs for a user

tools.name: hwl_create_profile
tools.description: Create a browser profile with its own fingerprint, cookies and history

tools.name: hwl_list_profiles
tools.description: List browser profiles

tools.name: hwl_delete_profile
tools.description: Delete a browser profile and its data

tools.name: hwl_import_cookies
tools.description: Import Netscape cookie file (requires HWL_API_KEY)

tools.name: hwl_element_state
tools.description: Computed style + ARIA state for selectors, without a screenshot

tools.name: hwl_upload
tools.description: Attach a file (url, base64, or path) to an upload field or drop zone

tools.name: hwl_batch
tools.description: Run several click/type/wait/scroll/navigate/read_text actions in one call

tools.name: hwl_save_page
tools.description: Save the current page or document, like Ctrl+S

tools.name: hwl_downloads
tools.description: List a tab's downloaded files or fetch one

scripts.build: tsc -p . || true; mkdir -p dist && cp plugin.js dist/plugin.js
scripts.test:mcp: npm ci --prefix mcp && node scripts/test-mcp.mjs && node scripts/test-mcp-package.mjs
scripts.test:container: bun run typecheck:container && bun run scripts/test-container.ts
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:web-ui && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:plugins
scripts.version: node scripts/sync-version.js && node scripts/generate-openapi.js && git add openclaw.plugin.json mcp/package.json mcp/package-lock.json openapi.json
